sheet.name: DC Peter Grant
sheet.backstory: Detective constable and Nightingale's apprentice practitioner; mixed heritage (Sierra Leonean mother, jazz-musician father), a working-class Londoner, and partner to the river goddess Beverley Brook.
sheet.magic_notes: plus all the others pells listed in the Chapter 4: Newtonian Magic up to (but not including) fourth order

custom_fields.value: This is where things get complicated. Nightingale's tick-tock precision is there, but after that, it's all over the place-music, laughter, the smell of chocolate, images of London-and, blimey, is it loud! So loud, in fact, that it hides what spell he's cueing up, meaning an adversary can't make a Magic skill roll to determine what spell he's about to fling at them
